# Multichannel Critter Sensor domain

## Overview
**Id:** blk-66bf60e22675

Multichannel Critter Sensor adds one building, the Multichannel Critter Sensor: a 1x1 room-based counter of critters and eggs that writes a 4-bit value to an Automation Ribbon output. Unlike the vanilla Critter Sensor it filters by species and egg type, can keep separate thresholds for critters and eggs, and pulses on every rise or fall of the count. It is unlocked by the Multiplexing tech and sits in Automation > Sensors. The art is a custom kanim by 3GuB under `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/anim/assets/critter_sensor_advanced/`.

## Key Entities
**Id:** blk-9b5f92f32e1e

### MultichannelCritterSensorConfig
**Id:** blk-47e6134bd352  
**Description**: The building definition (`IBuildingConfig`): ID `MultichannelCritterSensor`, 1x1, 50 kg Refined Metal and 50 kg Plastic, one ribbon output port at offset (0,0), logic overlay view, always operational, not overheatable, floodable or entombable.  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.cs`

**Relationships**: `DoPostConfigureComplete` adds the `MultichannelCritterSensor` component and the `OverlayInFrontOfConduits` tag. Registered with the logic overlay highlight list.

### MultichannelCritterSensor (component)
**Id:** blk-862f2299e270  
**Description**: The building's behaviour. Every 200 ms (`ISim200ms`) it finds the room the building is in, counts creatures and eggs in the room cavity that pass the species filters, compares the totals against the thresholds, and sends the packed value through the ribbon port.  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`

| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| separateThresholds | bool (saved) | Combined mode (false) or separate critter and egg thresholds (true) |
| countCritters / countEggs | bool (saved) | Whether each kind is counted at all |
| allCritters / allEggs | bool (saved) | The "All" row: every species counts, including ones discovered later |
| critterTags / eggTags | List<Tag> (saved) | Selected prefab tags when "All" is off |
| combinedThreshold, critterThreshold, eggThreshold | int (saved) | Thresholds, 0 to 64 (`MaxThreshold`) |
| combinedAbove, critterAbove, eggAbove | bool (saved) | Fire above (true) or below (false) the threshold |
| CritterCount, EggCount, InRoom, TrackedTotal, OutputValue | runtime | Last scan results; not saved |

**Relationships**: Uses `LogicPorts` to send the signal on `PortId` ("MultichannelCritterSensorOutput"), `Game.Instance.roomProber` and `Room.cavity.creatures` / `.eggs` for counting, `Game.Instance.logicCircuitManager.onLogicTick` to clear pulses, `CopyBuildingSettings` and the `CopySettings` event for copy-settings, and two `MeterController` indicators pinned to the kanim symbols `meter_target_critter` and `meter_target_egg`.

Output bits (`PrimaryBit`, `EggBit`, `RisingBit`, `FallingBit`):

| Bit (UI, 1-based) | Combined mode | Separate mode |
|-------------------|---------------|---------------|
| 1 | Combined count passes the threshold | Critter count passes its threshold |
| 2 | Off | Egg count passes its threshold |
| 3 | One-tick pulse when the tracked total rises | Same |
| 4 | One-tick pulse when the tracked total falls | Same |

### ThresholdAdapter
**Id:** blk-eeb8babf110d  
**Description**: A small `MonoBehaviour` implementing the game's `IThresholdSwitch`, one per threshold (`Kind.Combined`, `Kind.Critters`, `Kind.Eggs`). It lets a cloned vanilla `ThresholdSwitchSideScreen` read and write one of the sensor's three thresholds. Setting a value clamps it to 0..64 and calls `NotifyConfigChanged`.  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/ThresholdAdapter.cs`

**Relationships**: Lives on a helper game object owned by the side screen and points at the sensor. `RegisterNoUnits` puts an empty units string in the string table at mod load.

### MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen
**Id:** blk-e0e419cc8a18  
**Description**: The side screen (`SideScreenContent`, `IRender200ms`). The frame is PLib UI; the three threshold editors are runtime clones of the vanilla `ThresholdSwitchSideScreen` prefab; the species and egg lists are clones of the storage-filter row and element prefabs (`TreeFilterableSideScreen`) driven directly. Layout: count line, mode buttons (Combined / Separate), combined editor, then a Critters section and an Eggs section, each with a count checkbox, an "All" row, a species list and (in separate mode) its own threshold editor.  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`

**Relationships**: Reaches vanilla private fields through `AccessTools` (`DetailsScreen.sideScreens`, `ThresholdSwitchSideScreen.currentValue`, the `TreeFilterableSideScreen*` row and element fields). Lists come from discovered baggable species and discovered egg types, and refresh on the game's discovery event.

### Harmony patches
**Id:** blk-135266b0a795  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/Patches.cs`

| Patch target | Kind | Purpose |
|--------------|------|---------|
| `GeneratedBuildings.LoadGeneratedBuildings` | Prefix | `ModUtil.AddBuildingToPlanScreen("Automation", ..., "sensors", LogicCritterCountSensorConfig.ID, After)`: build menu slot after the vanilla Critter Sensor |
| `Db.Initialize` | Postfix | Adds the building to the `Multiplexing` tech's unlocked items; if the tech is missing, logs a warning and the building is available from the start |
| `DetailsScreen.OnPrefabInit` | Postfix | `PUIUtils.AddSideScreenContent<MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen>()` |

### Mod entry and strings
**Id:** blk-7d0135468c05  
**Location**: `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/Mod.cs`, `ModStrings.cs`, `translations/`
`MultichannelCritterSensorMod` initialises PLib (`PUtil.InitLibrary`), registers `ModStrings` through `Isochronous.Translations`, and calls `ThresholdAdapter.RegisterNoUnits()`. Chinese, Korean and Russian come from `translations/<locale>.po`. Mod id `Isochronous.MultichannelCritterSensor` (`mod.yaml`). All settings are saved with the building; the mod has no options screen.

## Business Rules
**Id:** blk-9aeb31887cd9

- Counting happens only inside a room. A sensor outside any room reads 0, shows the vanilla "Not in any room" status item, and resets its previous total.
- Critters and eggs are counted from the room cavity lists and filtered by `KPrefabID.PrefabTag`. With "All" on, every entry counts and newly discovered species are included.
- Leaving the "All" state by unticking one species keeps every other currently visible species selected.
- Thresholds are 0 to 64. Above means count greater than the threshold; below means count less than it.
- In combined mode bit 1 covers critters plus eggs (each only if its kind is counted) and bit 2 stays off. In separate mode bit 1 follows critters and bit 2 follows eggs.
- A rise or fall of the tracked total between two scans sets bit 3 or bit 4 for exactly one logic tick. A hatch (one egg out, one critter in) leaves the total unchanged and fires nothing. Changing configuration, copying settings, or leaving a room never fires a pulse (`lastTotal` resets to -1).
- Consecutive pulses are separated by at least one low tick, because `OnLogicTick` clears the pulse bits right after the circuit manager samples sender values.
- The output is a ribbon signal; a plain wire overloads when more than one bit is on.
- Copy settings copies every setting, with the tag lists cloned.
- Visuals: the body plays `on` once when the sensor starts seeing a tracked critter or egg and `off` when it sees none. Each meter plays `_off`, or a looping `_on` (with an `_on_pre` flicker when it turns on after spawn); the critter meter follows bit 1, the egg meter follows bit 2 in separate mode and bit 1 in combined mode.

## Key Code Paths
**Id:** blk-e47995daa09e

- **Scan and output**: `Sim200ms` calls `Evaluate`, which counts, sets pulse flags, builds the value, and calls `SetOutput` and `UpdateVisualState` — see `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`
- **Pulse clearing**: `OnLogicTick`, hooked to `logicCircuitManager.onLogicTick` in `OnSpawn` and unhooked in `OnCleanUp` — see `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`
- **Configuration edits**: side screen and adapters change fields, then `NotifyConfigChanged` rebuilds tag sets and re-evaluates — see `MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`, `ThresholdAdapter.cs`
- **Species toggling**: `SetAllSpecies`, `ToggleSpecies` — see `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`
- **Side screen build**: `EnsureBuilt`, `CreateThresholdEditor`, `CreateScrollList`, `RebuildList` — see `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`
- **Tests**: in-game `[OniTest]` cases in `src/MultichannelCritterSensor.Tests/` (`Config.cs` building, copy settings, save/load, thresholds; `Counting.cs` counting, pulses and no-room; `SideScreen.cs` UI; `Kit.cs` shared helpers)

## Related
**Id:** blk-d9d42360339f

- See also: [glossary](glossary.md)

# Multichannel Critter Sensor glossary

Terms for the Multichannel Critter Sensor mod. For the code behind them, see [entities](entities.md).

## Abbreviations and Acronyms
**Id:** blk-6e62c0f3760f

| Abbreviation | Full Term | Context |
|--------------|-----------|---------|
| ONI | Oxygen Not Included | The game this mod targets |
| MCS | Multichannel Critter Sensor | Prefix of the in-game test names in `src/MultichannelCritterSensor.Tests/` |
| PLib | Peter Han's mod library | Builds the side screen frame; merged into the mod DLL at build time |
| kanim | Klei animation | The building's art format, under `anim/assets/critter_sensor_advanced/` |

## Terms to Avoid
**Id:** blk-e2771d8b92cc

| Avoid | Use Instead | Reason |
|-------|-------------|--------|
| Bit 0 / bit 1 in player-facing text | Bit 1 / bit 2 | The UI and README count bits from 1; the code constants (`PrimaryBit` = 0) count from 0 |
| Count (alone) for a species filter | Species filter / All row | "Count" is also the threshold value name; the filter picks what is counted |
| Wire for the output | Automation Ribbon | A plain automation wire overloads when more than one bit is on |

## Cross-Domain Terms
**Id:** blk-99f829403aed

### Critter Sensor
**Id:** blk-58d1e4fb66c1  
**Definition**: The vanilla `LogicCritterCountSensor` (Automation > Sensors) that counts critters and eggs in a room and sends one green or red signal. This mod's building follows its counting method and sits right after it in the build menu.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`, `MultichannelCritterSensor.cs`

### Room and cavity
**Id:** blk-a7c784698924  
**Definition**: A room is a recognised enclosed area (`Room`); its cavity (`Room.cavity`) is the game's list of the creatures and eggs inside it. The sensor counts only entries in the cavity lists.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.Evaluate`

### Automation Ribbon / ribbon port
**Id:** blk-3d9352b59ea0  
**Definition**: A four-bit automation cable. The sensor's `RibbonOutputPort` writes all four bits; a Ribbon Reader splits it back into single wires.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.cs`

### Logic tick
**Id:** blk-4e6873004416  
**Definition**: The fixed 100 ms step at which the circuit manager samples every sender's value. A pulse bit lasts exactly one logic tick.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.OnLogicTick`

### Sim200ms
**Id:** blk-28e2f9fd0cb1  
**Definition**: The game's `ISim200ms` callback, called every 200 ms of game time. The sensor scans on it, so a pulse fires once per scan in which the total changed.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.Sim200ms`

### Threshold (above / below)
**Id:** blk-449051416ace  
**Definition**: The count a signal is compared against, 0 to 64, with a direction. The side screen uses the vanilla threshold editor (slider, number field, +/- buttons).  
**Used in**: `ThresholdAdapter.cs`

### Combined and separate mode
**Id:** blk-a2cbe7d177ab  
**Definition**: Combined: one threshold on critters plus eggs, output on bit 1. Separate: one threshold for critters (bit 1) and one for eggs (bit 2).  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.separateThresholds`

### Tracked total
**Id:** blk-029731d32878  
**Definition**: The critter count plus the egg count, each included only if its kind is ticked. Rises and falls of this value drive the pulse bits.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.TrackedTotal`

### Prefab tag
**Id:** blk-953f60378848  
**Definition**: `KPrefabID.PrefabTag`, the tag naming a species or egg type. Species selections are stored as these tags.  
**Used in**: `critterTags`, `eggTags`

### IThresholdSwitch
**Id:** blk-89218f16b429  
**Definition**: The game's interface for anything the threshold side screen can edit. `ThresholdAdapter` implements it so a cloned vanilla screen drives the sensor's thresholds.  
**Used in**: `ThresholdAdapter.cs`

### Multiplexing
**Id:** blk-0701cca2bd9a  
**Definition**: The research node that unlocks the building, two tiers past Animal Control, where the vanilla Critter Sensor unlocks.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`

### Copy settings
**Id:** blk-48503f178c60  
**Definition**: The vanilla tool that copies a building's settings to others of its kind via the `CopySettings` event and `CopyBuildingSettings`.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.OnCopySettings`

**Id:** blk-9b410f0c4294

**Definition**: The fixed 100 ms step at which the circuit manager samples every sender's value. A pulse bit lasts exactly one logic tick.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.OnLogicTick`

sections.title: Sim200ms
sections.text:
### Sim200ms
**Id:** blk-28e2f9fd0cb1  
**Definition**: The game's `ISim200ms` callback, called every 200 ms of game time. The sensor scans on it, so a pulse fires once per scan in which the total changed.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.Sim200ms`

sections.title: Threshold (above / below)
sections.text:
### Threshold (above / below)
**Id:** blk-449051416ace  
**Definition**: The count a signal is compared against, 0 to 64, with a direction. The side screen uses the vanilla threshold editor (slider, number field, +/- buttons).  
**Used in**: `ThresholdAdapter.cs`

sections.title: Combined and separate mode
sections.text:
### Combined and separate mode
**Id:** blk-a2cbe7d177ab  
**Definition**: Combined: one threshold on critters plus eggs, output on bit 1. Separate: one threshold for critters (bit 1) and one for eggs (bit 2).  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.separateThresholds`

sections.title: Tracked total
sections.text:
### Tracked total
**Id:** blk-029731d32878  
**Definition**: The critter count plus the egg count, each included only if its kind is ticked. Rises and falls of this value drive the pulse bits.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.TrackedTotal`

sections.title: Prefab tag
sections.text:
### Prefab tag
**Id:** blk-953f60378848  
**Definition**: `KPrefabID.PrefabTag`, the tag naming a species or egg type. Species selections are stored as these tags.  
**Used in**: `critterTags`, `eggTags`

sections.title: IThresholdSwitch
sections.text:
### IThresholdSwitch
**Id:** blk-89218f16b429  
**Definition**: The game's interface for anything the threshold side screen can edit. `ThresholdAdapter` implements it so a cloned vanilla screen drives the sensor's thresholds.  
**Used in**: `ThresholdAdapter.cs`

sections.title: Multiplexing
sections.text:
### Multiplexing
**Id:** blk-0701cca2bd9a  
**Definition**: The research node that unlocks the building, two tiers past Animal Control, where the vanilla Critter Sensor unlocks.  
**Used in**: `Patches.cs`

sections.title: Copy settings
sections.text:
### Copy settings
**Id:** blk-48503f178c60  
**Definition**: The vanilla tool that copies a building's settings to others of its kind via the `CopySettings` event and `CopyBuildingSettings`.  
**Used in**: `MultichannelCritterSensor.OnCopySettings`

# multichannel-critter-sensor

## What this is
**Id:** blk-3ed615c5605e

Multichannel Critter Sensor is an Oxygen Not Included mod that adds a room-based critter and egg counter for the Automation Ribbon. It counts critters and eggs in its room like the vanilla Critter Sensor, lets the player choose which species and egg types to count, and writes a 4-bit value to its ribbon output port, with combined or separate critter/egg thresholds and rising/falling count pulses. The building has its own kanim art by 3GuB, used with permission, and a side screen built from PLib UI plus clones of the vanilla threshold editors. Version 0.3.0 is released on the Steam Workshop (id 3804039425); `mod.yaml` sets `supportedContent: ALL` and `minimumSupportedBuild: 744825`. The mod is available in English, Chinese (Simplified), Korean and Russian.

## Where things are
**Id:** blk-c1548a895d61

- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/`: the mod. `Mod.cs` (entry point), `MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.cs` (building definition), `MultichannelCritterSensor.cs` (the counting component), `MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs` (the side screen), `ThresholdAdapter.cs` (exposes a threshold to the cloned vanilla editor), `Patches.cs` (build menu, research and details-screen patches), `ModStrings.cs`, `mod.yaml`, `mod_info.yaml`.
- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor/anim/` and `anim-original/`: the sensor's kanim art and the original art it came from; `translations/` holds the `.pot` template and `.po` files.
- `src/MultichannelCritterSensor.Tests/`: in-game tests (`Config.cs`, `Counting.cs`, `SideScreen.cs`, shared `Kit.cs`).
- `publish/`: Workshop material (`workshop-description.txt`, `workshop-id.txt`, `logo.jpg`, `preview.gif`).
- `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md`: user-facing description and release history.
- `.context/` holds `overview.md` (this file), `domains/` (entities and glossary), `standards/` (code style, error handling, naming conventions), `decisions/`, `retrospectives/`, `projects.md` and `META.md`.

# Code Style Guide

## Formatting
**Id:** blk-db2df7b40608

### Indentation
**Id:** blk-32ca28598b1a

- Tabs, one per level, in every `.cs` file (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Project files (`.csproj`, `common/oni-mod.props`, `common/oni-mod.targets`) use two spaces.
- Files are committed with LF line endings; Windows checkouts convert them to CRLF (`core.autocrlf` is true), so do not hand-normalise line endings.

### Line Length
**Id:** blk-2dbc3fdcc629

- No limit is configured and the repository has no `.editorconfig`.
- Wrap long calls and string concatenations after an argument or before a `+`, and indent the continuation one tab. The start-up log call in `mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Mod.cs` is the pattern.
- TODO(owner): decide whether to add an `.editorconfig` recording tabs and brace placement so editors enforce what the code already does.

### Braces
**Id:** blk-5a4d3f42fdd9

- Opening brace on its own line (Allman) for namespaces, types, members and multi-line control blocks.
- A body of one short statement goes on the next line without braces:

```csharp
foreach (Mod mod in mods)
{
	if (!mod.IsEnabledForActiveDlc())
		continue;
	...
}
```

- Multi-line initialisers and enums end with a trailing comma (`YieldToWorkshopIds` in `mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `CoolPodMode` in `mods/storage-pod-redux/src/StoragePodRedux/Options.cs`).

## Language and Toolchain
**Id:** blk-14ad76aa97d2

- C# 9 on .NET Framework 4.8 (`LangVersion` 9.0 and `TargetFramework` net48 in `common/oni-mod.props`). Namespace blocks, not file-scoped namespaces; no nullable reference types.
- Mods compile against the game's own assemblies (`common/oni-mod.targets`): `Assembly-CSharp`, `Assembly-CSharp-firstpass`, `0Harmony` and Unity modules. The game's .NET Framework lacks some newer APIs (`ConditionalWeakTable.AddOrUpdate` is missing, see `mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- Optional references are switched on in the mod csproj before the targets import: `ReferenceUnityUI`, `ReferenceImageConversion`, `UsePLib` (PLib is ILRepack-merged into the mod DLL) and `UseTranslations` (compiles `common/src/Translations.cs` in).
- One namespace per mod, equal to its `RootNamespace`. Subfolders organise files and do not add namespaces (`mods/upgrade-planner/src/UpgradePlanner/Plan`, `Rules`, `Tool`, `UI` all declare `namespace UpgradePlanner`).

## Imports/Includes
**Id:** blk-75e95367ad6e

### Organization
**Id:** blk-acc5909be8f5

`using` directives sit above the namespace, in one block with no blank lines, sorted alphabetically with `System.*` first. Aliases for `ModStrings` branches come last.

1. `System.*`
2. Everything else alphabetically: `HarmonyLib`, `Isochronous`, `KMod`, `Newtonsoft.Json`, `PeterHan.PLib.*`, `ProcGenGame`, `UnityEngine`
3. Aliases (`using TOOL = SweepZones.ModStrings.UI.TOOLS.SWEEPZONES;`)

### Example
**Id:** blk-353f3e62bd46

```csharp
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Reflection;
using HarmonyLib;
using Isochronous;
using Klei;
using KMod;
using STRINGS;
using UnityEngine;
```
(`mods/salty-surf/src/SaltySurf/Mod.cs`)

`Debug.Log` resolves either to `UnityEngine.Debug` or to the game's own global `Debug` class, so several `Mod.cs` files omit `using UnityEngine`. When a file imports `System.Diagnostics`, qualify the call as `UnityEngine.Debug.Log` (`mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).

## Comments
**Id:** blk-881b0a56757f

### When to Comment
**Id:** blk-4351aee3774b

- On every non-trivial class, an XML `<summary>` that says what the game does and what the patch changes, so a reader can check the patch against the game code. The long summary on `OvercrowdingMonitor_UpdateRegion_Patch` in `mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails/src/DontCountEggsOnRails/Mod.cs` is the model.
- Where a game quirk forces an odd line: `// The game's .NET Framework has no AddOrUpdate on this table.`
- Where another mod is involved, name it and its Workshop id (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`, `mods/smart-weight-plate/src/SmartWeightPlate/Mod.cs`).
- Escape angle brackets in XML comments as `<` and `>`.

### When NOT to Comment
**Id:** blk-d13ab5d202ab

- Code that reads clearly from its names.
- Commented-out code; delete it.
- Restating what a line does.

### Format
**Id:** blk-04a0583ea1e6

```csharp
/// <summary>
/// The "Any" choice. It is a tag like the elements a sensor's Filterable holds, so it rides
/// in the same saved field and copies with the building's settings.
/// </summary>
public static class AnyElement

// Single-line note for a quirk or a reason.
```

## Control Structures
**Id:** blk-51cb4629391a

### Conditionals
**Id:** blk-887f49b2fb23

Guard clauses and early `return` or `continue` keep nesting shallow (`SettleSimBackwalls.UpdateFromSim` in `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere/src/NaturalBackwalls/SettleSimPatch.cs`):

```csharp
if (!Grid.IsValidCell(cell))
	continue;
ushort idx = data->backwallElement[cell];
if (idx == ushort.MaxValue || idx >= elements.Count)
	continue;
```

### Loops
**Id:** blk-483b9df9284d

- Plain `for` and `foreach`. Code that runs every sim tick or frame avoids LINQ and allocations; reuse scratch lists (`scratch` in `mods/just-fall-already/src/JustFallAlready/FallPoke.cs`).
- Local types are written out (`Tech tech = ...`). `var` appears mainly in `mods/upgrade-planner`, `mods/natural-backwalls-everywhere` and the test projects; follow the surrounding file.

### Strings
**Id:** blk-78445078aafc

- Log and UI text is built with `+` concatenation, or `string.Format` on a `LocString`. String interpolation is not used in mod code.
- Player-visible text is a `LocString` field in `ModStrings`, never a literal at the call site (see [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)).

## Harmony Patches
**Id:** blk-e676d65391a9

- A patch is a static class with `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), nameof(Type.Method))]`, or `[HarmonyPatch(typeof(Type), "PrivateMethod")]` for a non-public method, and methods named `Prefix`, `Postfix`, `Transpiler` or `Finalizer` (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Patches.cs`).
- Game state arrives through Harmony parameters: `__instance`, `__result`, `___field`. Fields read repeatedly use `AccessTools.FieldRefAccess` kept in a `static readonly` field (`mods/detect-any-element/src/DetectAnyElement/Patches.cs`).
- A prefix returns `true` to let the game's method run and `false` only when it replaces the method (`mods/dont-count-eggs-on-rails`, `mods/bitshifter` `UpdateVisuals`).
- A patch that depends on an option implements `Prepare()` (`mods/jumper-bridges/src/JumperBridges/Patches.cs`); a patch with several targets implements `TargetMethods()`.
- `UserMod2.OnLoad` calls `base.OnLoad(harmony)`, which applies every patch in the assembly, then registers libraries and logs the version. A mod that must patch after all others applies its patches from `OnAllModsLoaded` instead (`mods/bitshifter/src/Bitshifter/Mod.cs`).
- Transpilers search for the instruction they change and report when it is not found; see [error handling](error-handling.md).

## Game Components
**Id:** blk-0e2beaa499b3

- A component extends `KMonoBehaviour`, overrides `OnPrefabInit`, `OnSpawn` and `OnCleanUp` and calls `base` from each. Sibling components come in through `[MyCmpGet]` or `[MyCmpReq]` (`mods/no-magic-fridges/src/NoMagicFridges/FridgeThermostat.cs`).
- Saved state uses `[Serialize]` fields with `[SerializationConfig(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` on the class (`mods/sweep-zones/src/SweepZones/ZoneStore.cs`).
- Components are added to prefabs from a `DoPostConfigureComplete` postfix with `go.AddOrGet<T>()`.

## Project-Specific Rules
**Id:** blk-67f23c4b455d

- Mod options are a PLib `POptions` class marked `[JsonObject(MemberSerialization.OptIn)]` and `[ConfigFile(SharedConfigLocation: true)]`, read through a static `Load()` (`mods/vent-freeze-fix/src/VentFreezeFix/Options.cs`) or through `SingletonOptions<Options>` (`mods/storage-pod-redux`). Option titles are string-table keys, so the translation follows the language.
- Every mod logs one line at load: `[<Name>] Loaded version <assembly version>`.
- Tests live in a separate `<Name>.Tests` project and are written as `[OniTest]` coroutines against the real game.

### Multichannel Critter Sensor specifics
**Id:** blk-0bd1ebe66e1f

- `UsePLib`, `UseTranslations` and `ReferenceUnityUI`. `Mod.cs` initialises PLib, registers translations and calls `ThresholdAdapter.RegisterNoUnits()`.
- `Patches.cs` is a `public static class Patches` holding the nested patch classes: build-menu placement (`ModUtil.AddBuildingToPlanScreen`), research unlock (`Db_Initialize_Patch`, `TechId` "Multiplexing"), and side-screen registration (`PUIUtils.AddSideScreenContent`).
- The side screen (`MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`) is built with PLib UI and clones vanilla prefabs; `ThresholdAdapter` is an `internal sealed` `MonoBehaviour` implementing `IThresholdSwitch`.
- `MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.ID` is the building id.

## Related
**Id:** blk-0c78ac8acc8d

- See also: [naming conventions](naming-conventions.md)
- See also: [error handling](error-handling.md)

**Id:** blk-0bd1ebe66e1f

- `UsePLib`, `UseTranslations` and `ReferenceUnityUI`. `Mod.cs` initialises PLib, registers translations and calls `ThresholdAdapter.RegisterNoUnits()`.
- `Patches.cs` is a `public static class Patches` holding the nested patch classes: build-menu placement (`ModUtil.AddBuildingToPlanScreen`), research unlock (`Db_Initialize_Patch`, `TechId` "Multiplexing"), and side-screen registration (`PUIUtils.AddSideScreenContent`).
- The side screen (`MultichannelCritterSensorSideScreen.cs`) is built with PLib UI and clones vanilla prefabs; `ThresholdAdapter` is an `internal sealed` `MonoBehaviour` implementing `IThresholdSwitch`.
- `MultichannelCritterSensorConfig.ID` is the building id.
